## Value tables

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT AS VALUE a FROM t)
=> "4"

SELECT AS VALUE 7
=> "7"

SELECT AS VALUE STRUCT(a AS x) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "1"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT a, b AS name FROM t WHERE a IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a DESC))
=> "[{\"a\":3,\"name\":\"あ\"},{\"a\":2,\"name\":\"yy\"},{\"a\":1,\"name\":\"x\"}]"

## Table reads, ordering and limits

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT BYTE_LENGTH(b) AS bytes, BYTE_LENGTH(raw) AS raw_bytes
  FROM t WHERE a >= 1 AND a < 4 ORDER BY a DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 1))
=> "[{\"bytes\":2,\"raw_bytes\":null},{\"bytes\":1,\"raw_bytes\":1}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT q.a AS x, q.b AS y, q.a + 10 AS `_c1`
  FROM (SELECT a + 1 AS a, b FROM t WHERE a IS NOT NULL) AS q WHERE q.a > 2 ORDER BY q.a DESC))
=> "[{\"x\":4,\"y\":\"あ\",\"_c1\":14},{\"x\":3,\"y\":\"yy\",\"_c1\":13}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT * EXCEPT (raw) REPLACE (a * 10 AS a) FROM t
  WHERE a IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a DESC LIMIT 1))
=> "[{\"a\":30,\"b\":\"あ\"}]"

# A select list that reads no column of the table keeps its rows.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT 42 FROM t))
=> "[42,42,42,42]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT 42 FROM t LIMIT 2))
=> "[42,42]"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(ARRAY(SELECT 42 FROM t WHERE FALSE))
=> "0"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(ARRAY(SELECT a FROM t LIMIT 0))
=> "0"

# NULLs sort first in ascending order and last in descending order.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/query-syntax#order_by_clause
SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY a LIMIT 1
=> null

SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY a ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1
=> null

SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY a DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1
=> null

SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY a DESC LIMIT 1
=> "3"

SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY a DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
=> "3"

SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY a ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
=> "1"

SELECT a FROM (SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY a DESC LIMIT 2) ORDER BY a LIMIT 1
=> "2"

SELECT a FROM t WHERE a IS NOT NULL ORDER BY -a LIMIT 1
=> "3"

SELECT -a AS a FROM t WHERE a IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1
=> "-3"

SELECT nope FROM t
=> error contains: Unrecognized name: nope

## Conditions

SELECT STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN a IS NULL THEN 'null' WHEN a = 1 THEN 'one' ELSE 'other' END, ','
  ORDER BY a)
FROM t
=> "null,one,other,other"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(CASE a WHEN 1 THEN 10 WHEN 2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY a)) FROM t
=> "[0,10,20,0]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT IF(a IS NULL, 0, a) AS i, COALESCE(a, 5) AS c,
  IFNULL(a, 6) AS n, NULLIF(a, 1) AS z FROM t ORDER BY a))
=> "[{\"i\":0,\"c\":5,\"n\":6,\"z\":null},{\"i\":1,\"c\":1,\"n\":1,\"z\":null},{\"i\":2,\"c\":2,\"n\":2,\"z\":2},{\"i\":3,\"c\":3,\"n\":3,\"z\":3}]"

# IF evaluates only the branch it returns.
SELECT IF(a = 1, 42, 1 / (a - 1)) FROM t WHERE a = 1
=> "42.0"

SELECT IF(FALSE, 1 / 0, 42)
=> "42.0"

## Joins and WITH clauses

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT l.a + r.a FROM t AS l JOIN t AS r ON l.a = r.a ORDER BY 1))
=> "[2,4,6]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT r.b FROM t AS l LEFT JOIN t AS r ON l.a = r.a + 1
  ORDER BY l.a NULLS LAST))
=> "[null,\"x\",\"yy\",null]"

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t AS l CROSS JOIN t AS r
=> "16"

# NULL keys match nothing, so the row with a NULL appears on each side unmatched.
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t AS l FULL JOIN t AS r ON l.a = r.a
=> "5"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT a FROM t JOIN (SELECT 2 AS a) USING (a)))
=> "[2]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(WITH c AS (SELECT a * 10 AS x FROM t), d AS (SELECT x FROM c WHERE x > 10)
  SELECT x FROM d ORDER BY x DESC))
=> "[30,20]"

WITH c AS (SELECT 1 AS x) SELECT l.x + r.x FROM c AS l, c AS r
=> "2"

## Aggregates and grouping

SELECT SUM(a) FROM t
=> "6"

SELECT COUNT(a) FROM t
=> "3"

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a) FROM t
=> "3"

SELECT AVG(a) FROM t
=> "2.0"

SELECT MIN(b) FROM t
=> "x"

SELECT MAX(b) FROM t
=> "あ"

SELECT STRING_AGG(b, ',' ORDER BY a DESC) FROM t
=> "あ,yy,x"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(ARRAY_AGG(a IGNORE NULLS)) FROM t
=> "3"

SELECT COUNTIF(a > 1) FROM t
=> "2"

SELECT LOGICAL_AND(a > 0) FROM t
=> "true"

SELECT LOGICAL_AND(a) FROM UNNEST([TRUE, FALSE]) AS a
=> "false"

SELECT LOGICAL_OR(a) FROM UNNEST([TRUE, FALSE]) AS a
=> "true"

SELECT MOD(a, 2) AS k FROM t WHERE a IS NOT NULL GROUP BY k HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
=> "1"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT a > 1 AS big FROM t ORDER BY big))
=> "[null,false,true]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT ANY_VALUE(b HAVING MIN a) FROM t WHERE a IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY MOD(a, 2) ORDER BY MOD(a, 2)))
=> "[\"yy\",\"x\"]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT a > 1 AS big, COUNT(*) AS n, GROUPING(a > 1) AS g
  FROM t WHERE a IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ROLLUP(big) ORDER BY g, big))
=> "[{\"big\":false,\"n\":1,\"g\":0},{\"big\":true,\"n\":2,\"g\":0},{\"big\":null,\"n\":3,\"g\":1}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT a, b, COUNT(*) AS n FROM t WHERE a < 3
  GROUP BY CUBE(a, b) ORDER BY a NULLS LAST, b NULLS LAST))
=> "[{\"a\":1,\"b\":\"x\",\"n\":1},{\"a\":1,\"b\":null,\"n\":1},{\"a\":2,\"b\":\"yy\",\"n\":1},{\"a\":2,\"b\":null,\"n\":1},{\"a\":null,\"b\":\"x\",\"n\":1},{\"a\":null,\"b\":\"yy\",\"n\":1},{\"a\":null,\"b\":null,\"n\":2}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT a, b, SUM(a) AS s FROM t WHERE a < 3
  GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((a, b), a, ()) ORDER BY 3, 1, 2))
=> "[{\"a\":1,\"b\":null,\"s\":1},{\"a\":1,\"b\":\"x\",\"s\":1},{\"a\":2,\"b\":null,\"s\":2},{\"a\":2,\"b\":\"yy\",\"s\":2},{\"a\":null,\"b\":null,\"s\":3}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT a, b, COUNT(*) AS n FROM t WHERE a < 3
  GROUP BY a, ROLLUP(b) ORDER BY a, b NULLS LAST))
=> "[{\"a\":1,\"b\":\"x\",\"n\":1},{\"a\":1,\"b\":null,\"n\":1},{\"a\":2,\"b\":\"yy\",\"n\":1},{\"a\":2,\"b\":null,\"n\":1}]"

SELECT GROUPING(a) FROM t WHERE a = 1 GROUP BY a
=> "0"

## Recursive WITH clauses

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(WITH RECURSIVE c AS (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM c
  WHERE n < 3) SELECT n FROM c ORDER BY n))
=> "[1,2,3]"

# UNION DISTINCT stops once an iteration adds no new row.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(WITH RECURSIVE c AS (SELECT 0 AS n UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT MOD(n + 1, 3) FROM c) SELECT n FROM c ORDER BY n))
=> "[0,1,2]"

# A plain entry next to a recursive one, and a recursive term that joins a table and filters
# through a subquery.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(WITH RECURSIVE base AS (SELECT a FROM t WHERE a IS NOT NULL),
  c AS (SELECT MIN(a) AS n, 1 AS depth FROM base UNION ALL
    SELECT base.a, depth + 1 FROM c JOIN base ON base.a = c.n + 1
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base WHERE a > c.n))
  SELECT AS STRUCT n, depth FROM c ORDER BY depth))
=> "[{\"n\":1,\"depth\":1},{\"n\":2,\"depth\":2},{\"n\":3,\"depth\":3}]"

## Set operations

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 ORDER BY x))
=> "[1,1,2]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT a FROM t UNION DISTINCT SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY a))
=> "[null,1,2,3]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT a FROM t INTERSECT DISTINCT SELECT 2))
=> "[2]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT a FROM t WHERE a IS NOT NULL EXCEPT DISTINCT SELECT 2
  ORDER BY 1))
=> "[1,3]"

# CORRESPONDING matches columns by name.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/query-syntax#corresponding
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT * FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 2 AS b
  UNION ALL CORRESPONDING SELECT 3 AS b, 4 AS a) ORDER BY a))
=> "[{\"a\":1,\"b\":2},{\"a\":4,\"b\":3}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT * FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 2 AS b
  FULL UNION ALL CORRESPONDING SELECT 3 AS c, 4 AS a) ORDER BY a))
=> "[{\"a\":1,\"b\":2,\"c\":null},{\"a\":4,\"b\":null,\"c\":3}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT * FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 2 AS b
  LEFT UNION ALL CORRESPONDING SELECT 3 AS c, 4 AS a) ORDER BY a))
=> "[{\"a\":1,\"b\":2},{\"a\":4,\"b\":null}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT * FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 2 AS b
  INNER UNION ALL CORRESPONDING SELECT 3 AS c, 4 AS a) ORDER BY a))
=> "[{\"a\":1},{\"a\":4}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT * FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 2 AS b, 5 AS c
  UNION ALL CORRESPONDING BY (c, a) SELECT 3 AS c, 4 AS a) ORDER BY a))
=> "[{\"c\":5,\"a\":1},{\"c\":3,\"a\":4}]"

SELECT a FROM (SELECT a, b FROM t INTERSECT DISTINCT CORRESPONDING SELECT 'x' AS b, 1 AS a)
=> "1"

## Lateral joins

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT t.a, s.m FROM t, LATERAL (SELECT MAX(u.a) AS m
  FROM t AS u WHERE u.a < t.a) AS s ORDER BY t.a))
=> "[{\"a\":null,\"m\":null},{\"a\":1,\"m\":null},{\"a\":2,\"m\":1},{\"a\":3,\"m\":2}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT t.a, s.b FROM t LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT u.b
  FROM t AS u WHERE u.a = t.a + 1) AS s ON s.b != 'yy' ORDER BY t.a))
=> "[{\"a\":null,\"b\":null},{\"a\":1,\"b\":null},{\"a\":2,\"b\":\"あ\"},{\"a\":3,\"b\":null}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT s.n FROM t JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM t AS u
  WHERE u.a <= t.a) AS s ON s.n > 1 ORDER BY t.a))
=> "[2,3]"

# The lateral side also sees columns of the query enclosing the join.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT (SELECT SUM(s.x) FROM UNNEST([10, 20]) AS o,
  LATERAL (SELECT o + t.a AS x) AS s) FROM t ORDER BY t.a))
=> "[null,32,34,36]"

## Analytic functions and QUALIFY

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a) AS r,
  SUM(a) OVER (ORDER BY a ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS s,
  LAG(a) OVER (ORDER BY a) AS l,
  FIRST_VALUE(a IGNORE NULLS) OVER (ORDER BY a ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS f
  FROM t ORDER BY a))
=> "[{\"r\":1,\"s\":null,\"l\":null,\"f\":1},{\"r\":2,\"s\":1,\"l\":null,\"f\":1},{\"r\":3,\"s\":3,\"l\":1,\"f\":1},{\"r\":4,\"s\":5,\"l\":2,\"f\":1}]"

SELECT b FROM t WHERE a IS NOT NULL QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a DESC) = 1
=> "あ"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT a, COUNT(DISTINCT MOD(a, 2)) OVER (PARTITION BY a > 1) AS c,
  SUM(DISTINCT a) OVER () AS s FROM (SELECT a FROM t UNION ALL SELECT a FROM t)
  WHERE a IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a))
=> "[{\"a\":1,\"c\":1,\"s\":6},{\"a\":1,\"c\":1,\"s\":6},{\"a\":2,\"c\":2,\"s\":6},{\"a\":2,\"c\":2,\"s\":6},{\"a\":3,\"c\":2,\"s\":6},{\"a\":3,\"c\":2,\"s\":6}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT name, score FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS id, 'a' AS name,
  10 AS score), (2, 'b', 30), (3, 'a', 20)]) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY name ORDER BY
  score DESC) = 1 ORDER BY name))
=> "[{\"name\":\"a\",\"score\":20},{\"name\":\"b\",\"score\":30}]"

## Subqueries

SELECT (SELECT MAX(a) FROM t)
=> "3"

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t WHERE a = 2)
=> "true"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT b FROM t WHERE b IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a DESC), ',')
=> "あ,yy,x"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(ARRAY(SELECT a FROM t WHERE FALSE))
=> "0"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT a FROM t WHERE a IN (SELECT a + 1 FROM t) ORDER BY a))
=> "[2,3]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t AS i WHERE i.a < o.a) FROM t AS o
  WHERE o.a IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.a))
=> "[0,1,2]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT a FROM t AS o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT a FROM t
  WHERE a > o.a)) ORDER BY a))
=> "[1,2]"

## Unnest structs and arrays

SELECT SUM(x) FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 3]) AS x
=> "6"

SELECT s.y FROM (SELECT STRUCT(1 AS x, 'z' AS y) AS s)
=> "z"

SELECT [10, 20, 30][OFFSET(1)]
=> "20"

SELECT [10, 20, 30][ORDINAL(1)]
=> "10"

SELECT [10, 20, 30][SAFE_OFFSET(3)]
=> null

SELECT [10, 20, 30][OFFSET(3)]
=> error:

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT x, o FROM UNNEST(['a', 'b']) AS x WITH OFFSET AS o
  ORDER BY o DESC))
=> "[{\"x\":\"b\",\"o\":1},{\"x\":\"a\",\"o\":0}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT x FROM t LEFT JOIN UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(1, a - 1)) AS x
  WHERE a IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a, x))
=> "[null,1,1,2]"

# Unnesting several arrays pads the shorter ones with NULLs, or truncates the longer ones.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/query-syntax#unnest_operator
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT x, y, o FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 3] AS x, ['a'] AS y)
  WITH OFFSET AS o ORDER BY o))
=> "[{\"x\":1,\"y\":\"a\",\"o\":0},{\"x\":2,\"y\":null,\"o\":1},{\"x\":3,\"y\":null,\"o\":2}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT x, y FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 3] AS x, ['a', 'b'] AS y,
  mode => 'TRUNCATE') ORDER BY x))
=> "[{\"x\":1,\"y\":\"a\"},{\"x\":2,\"y\":\"b\"}]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT a, x, y FROM t, UNNEST([a] AS x,
  CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<STRING>) AS y) WHERE a IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a))
=> "[{\"a\":1,\"x\":1,\"y\":null},{\"a\":2,\"x\":2,\"y\":null},{\"a\":3,\"x\":3,\"y\":null}]"

SELECT x FROM UNNEST([1, 2] AS x, [3] AS y, mode => 'STRICT')
=> error:

## DML
# Each script changes a temporary copy of t, since the cases share t.

CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT * FROM scalars.t;
INSERT INTO t VALUES (10, 'v', b'\x01'), (11, CONCAT('w', 'x'), NULL);
INSERT INTO t (b, a, raw) VALUES ('reordered', 12, DEFAULT);
INSERT t (a) SELECT a + 100 FROM t WHERE a IN (1, 2) ORDER BY a;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT a, b, TO_HEX(raw) AS raw FROM t WHERE a >= 10 ORDER BY a))
=> "[{\"a\":10,\"b\":\"v\",\"raw\":\"01\"},{\"a\":11,\"b\":\"wx\",\"raw\":null},{\"a\":12,\"b\":\"reordered\",\"raw\":null},{\"a\":101,\"b\":null,\"raw\":null},{\"a\":102,\"b\":null,\"raw\":null}]"

CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT * FROM scalars.t;
UPDATE t SET b = CONCAT(b, '!'), raw = DEFAULT WHERE a = 1;
UPDATE t AS x SET a = x.a * 10 WHERE x.a > 1;
UPDATE t SET b = s.b FROM (SELECT 30 AS a, 'from' AS b) AS s WHERE t.a = s.a;
DELETE t WHERE a IS NULL;
DELETE FROM t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST([20]) AS v WHERE v = t.a);
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT a, b, raw IS NULL AS n FROM t ORDER BY a))
=> "[{\"a\":1,\"b\":\"x!\",\"n\":true},{\"a\":30,\"b\":\"from\",\"n\":false}]"

# A struct field assignment rebuilds the struct around it, keeping the fields it leaves alone, and
# fails where the struct is NULL.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/dml-syntax#update_statement
CREATE TEMP TABLE st AS SELECT id, s FROM UNNEST([
  STRUCT(1 AS id, STRUCT(1 AS x, STRUCT('a' AS z, 10 AS w) AS y) AS s),
  (2, STRUCT(2, NULL)), (3, NULL)]);
UPDATE st SET s.x = s.x + 100, s.y.z = 'b' WHERE id = 1;
UPDATE st SET s.y = STRUCT('c', 20) WHERE id = 2;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT s FROM st WHERE id < 3 ORDER BY id))
=> "[{\"x\":101,\"y\":{\"z\":\"b\",\"w\":10}},{\"x\":2,\"y\":{\"z\":\"c\",\"w\":20}}]"

CREATE TEMP TABLE st AS SELECT 3 AS id, CAST(NULL AS STRUCT<x INT64>) AS s;
UPDATE st SET s.x = 1 WHERE id = 3
=> error:

CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT * FROM scalars.t;
MERGE t USING (SELECT 1 AS a, 'one' AS b UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'five') AS s ON t.a = s.a
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET b = s.b
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (a, b) VALUES (s.a, s.b)
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE AND t.a = 2 THEN DELETE
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN UPDATE SET b = 'gone';
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT a, b FROM t ORDER BY a))
=> "[{\"a\":null,\"b\":\"gone\"},{\"a\":1,\"b\":\"one\"},{\"a\":3,\"b\":\"gone\"},{\"a\":5,\"b\":\"five\"}]"

CREATE TEMP TABLE t AS SELECT * FROM scalars.t;
MERGE INTO t AS d USING (SELECT 5 AS a, 'five' AS b, CAST(NULL AS BYTES) AS raw
  UNION ALL SELECT 1, 'new', NULL UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'new', b'z') AS s ON d.a = s.a
WHEN MATCHED AND d.b = 'x' THEN DELETE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ROW;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT a FROM t WHERE a IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a))
=> "[2,3,5,7]"

## CREATE TABLE AS SELECT
# A column list names the query's columns in order.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/data-definition-language#create_table_statement

CREATE TEMP TABLE c (n INT64, label STRING) AS SELECT a * 10, b FROM scalars.t WHERE a IS NOT NULL;
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT * FROM c ORDER BY n))
=> "[{\"n\":10,\"label\":\"x\"},{\"n\":20,\"label\":\"yy\"},{\"n\":30,\"label\":\"あ\"}]"
